senses.title: Liquid in tiny flying drops
senses.definition: masses of very small drops of liquid carried in the air
senses.definitionCN: 悬浮在空中的大量细小液滴
senses.example: The sea spray reached the cliff path.
senses.exampleCN: 海浪的飞沫溅到了崖边小径。
senses.why: One stream is broken into a thousand wings: liquid learns to fly.
senses.whyCN: 一股水流折成千只翅膀：液体学会了飞。

senses.title: To scatter liquid in drops
senses.definition: to force liquid through a small hole so it falls as drops
senses.definitionCN: 使液体经小孔喷出成滴
senses.example: Farmers sprayed the orchard before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 果农天亮前给果园喷了药。
senses.why: A squeezed mouth turns one river into rain.
senses.whyCN: 捏扁的管口把一条河变成雨。

senses.title: A container of liquid for spraying
senses.definition: a container that sends out liquid as a fine mist
senses.definitionCN: 喷出细雾的容器
senses.example: She keeps a spray of lavender water by the bed.
senses.exampleCN: 她床头放着一瓶薰衣草水喷雾。
senses.why: The machine bottles the rain for one squeeze of a finger.
senses.whyCN: 机器把雨水装瓶，只待指尖一按。

senses.title: A small cluster of flowers or gems
senses.definition: a small branch with flowers or leaves, or gems arranged like one
senses.definitionCN: 带花的细枝，或仿此镶饰的珠宝
senses.example: The bride wore a spray of white orchids.
senses.exampleCN: 新娘佩戴一簇白兰花。
senses.why: The flying drops freeze into a bouquet's shape.
senses.whyCN: 飞散的水滴凝成花束的形状。

senses.title: To wet with flying drops
senses.definition: to cover something with flying drops or splashes
senses.definitionCN: 以飞沫或泼溅覆盖某物
senses.example: The passing bus sprayed mud over the fence.
senses.exampleCN: 驶过的公交车把泥浆溅上围栏。
senses.why: What flies from the wheel must land somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 从车轮飞出的东西终要落地。

senses.title: To direct a stream of shots
senses.definition: to fire bullets over a wide area
senses.definitionCN: 向大片区域射击
senses.example: The guards sprayed the fence line with gunfire.
senses.exampleCN: 守卫朝围栏一线扫射。
senses.why: Drops become bullets: many small strikes instead of one big one.
senses.whyCN: 水滴变成子弹：以许多小打击替代一次大打击。

senses.title: Spray paint or graffiti
senses.definition: paint applied through a pressurized can or gun
senses.definitionCN: 经压力罐或喷枪喷出的漆
senses.example: The wall was covered in spray paint overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 一夜之间墙面喷满了漆。
senses.why: Colour, too, can learn to fly in fine drops.
senses.whyCN: 色彩也能学会化作细滴飞行。

senses.title: A sprayer: the tool
senses.definition: a device or person that sends out spray
senses.definitionCN: 喷出雾的器具或人
senses.example: The old sprayer wheeled between the greenhouse rows.
senses.exampleCN: 旧喷雾器在温室行列间推行。
senses.why: The hand builds a metal mouth for the squeezed stream.
senses.whyCN: 手为捏扁的水流造了一副金属嘴。

intro.en: Spray is a northern word of flying drops, kin to the splash-family of the sea.
intro.cn: spray 是「飞沫」的北方词，与海的泼溅词族为亲。

items.en: *sprei- is generally reconstructed as "to scatter, sprinkle"; the deeper origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为原始日耳曼语 *sprei- 表示「散布、洒」；更早来源不确定。

items.en: Middle Dutch spraye meant a twig or a scattered spray of water, the recorded bridge.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 spraye 指细枝或散开的水花，是有记录的桥。

items.en: Some sources link Old English spræc and the noun spray of drops through the same Low German sea-words.
items.cn: 一些辞源通过低地德语海词把古英语形式与水沫名词相联。

items.en: The word settled in English in the sixteenth century for sea spray and twigs alike.
items.cn: 该词于十六世纪定型，兼指海沫与花枝。

items.en: Aerosol technology gave the word its modern bottle and its verb of choice.
items.cn: 气雾技术给这个词带来现代的喷雾瓶与常用动词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers near spellings; the near-meaning group gathers words of scattering and drops.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写相近的词；近义组收表示散布与液滴的词。

entries.definition: A device or person that sprays.
entries.definitionCN: 喷洒的器具或人。

entries.definition: The past form, as in freshly painted surfaces.
entries.definitionCN: 过去式，如新喷的漆面。

entries.definition: A device for painting with pressured paint.
entries.definitionCN: 喷漆用的喷枪。

entries.definition: A burst of activity; merely looks alike and is of different origin.
entries.definitionCN: 义为「狂欢一阵」；只是形近，词源不同。

entries.definition: A digging tool; shares the sp- opening but has another root.
entries.definitionCN: 义为「铲子」；同以 sp- 开头但词根不同。

entries.definition: Fine water drops hanging in air, slower to fall.
entries.definitionCN: 悬在空气中的细水滴，下落更缓。

entries.definition: Liquid thrown in clumps, larger than drops.
entries.definitionCN: 成团飞出的液体，大于水滴。

entries.definition: To scatter drops lightly, by hand or rain.
entries.definitionCN: 轻轻洒布水滴，用手或雨。

entries.definition: Light fine rain falling steadily.
entries.definitionCN: 连绵的细雨。

entries.definition: A suspension of drops in gas, the technical term.
entries.definitionCN: 气悬液滴，专业术语。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the squeezed-hose image and the flower cluster the word also names.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用捏扁的水管意象，以及该词兼指的花簇。

normal.en: Spray the plants: the hose mouth squeezed turns river into rain.
normal.cn: spray the plants：捏扁的管口把河变成雨。

normal.en: Sea spray is the ocean thrown into the air.
normal.cn: sea spray 是被抛上天的海。

normal.en: A spray of flowers is a branch that scattered like drops.
normal.cn: a spray of flowers 是像水滴一样散开的花枝。

normal.en: Hair spray holds a hairstyle the way mist holds on leaves.
normal.cn: hair spray 固定发型，如雾停在叶上。

normal.en: Spray paint flies through a nozzle, colour as fine rain.
normal.cn: spray paint 经喷嘴飞出，色彩如细雨。

abstract.en: Picture the fan of water catching light, a rainbow in the mist.
abstract.cn: 想象扇形水雾折射光线，雾中一段彩虹。

abstract.en: The same word flies in two directions: water upward, flowers downward.
abstract.cn: 同一个词向两个方向飞：水向上，花向下。

abstract.en: A thousand drops do the work of one river, gently.
abstract.cn: 千滴水温柔地完成一条河的工作。

examples.en: He sprayed the roses against greenfly every morning.
examples.cn: 他每天清晨给玫瑰喷药防蚜虫。

examples.en: White spray exploded against the harbour wall.
examples.cn: 白色浪花在防波堤上炸开。

examples.en: The florist added a spray of baby's breath to the bouquet.
examples.cn: 花匠在花束里添了一簇满天星。

root: spray 属日耳曼语源，一般认为原始日耳曼语 *sprei- 表示「散布、洒」，经中古荷兰语 spraye「细枝；水花」进入英语，更早来源不确定。水沫与花枝二义并存至今。

sensesIntro.en: The senses of spray all break one stream into many: flying drops, the bottle of them, the flower cluster, and the rain of bullets.
sensesIntro.cn: spray 的义项都把一股流折成许多：飞沫、喷雾瓶、花簇与弹雨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a squeezed hose fanning a rainbow into the flower bed.
core.cn: 核心意象：捏扁的水管向花圃扇出一段彩虹。

branches.en: THE DROPS LINE: the river broken into wings that must land.
branches.cn: 水滴线：河流折翼，终须落地。

branches.en: THE BOTTLE LINE: rain bottled for one finger-squeeze.
branches.cn: 瓶装线：雨水入瓶，只待一按。

branches.en: THE BLOOM LINE: scattered drops freeze into a bouquet.
branches.cn: 花朵线：散开的水滴凝成花束。

branches.en: THE BULLETS LINE: many small strikes replace one big one.
branches.cn: 弹雨线：以多次小打击替代一次大打击。

branches.en: THE PAINT LINE: colour learns to fly as fine rain.
branches.cn: 喷漆线：色彩学会化作细雨飞行。
